conditions.displayName: Failed executions of Cloud Run job __JOB__

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "__JOB__" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = monitoring.regex.full_match("fail.*")

documentation.content: The Cloud Run job `__JOB__` (traffic and weather collector) had a failed execution. The job fails only if every Routes or Weather call fails, or on a BigQuery or startup error. Check the logs: `gcloud run jobs executions list --job __JOB__ --region __REGION__` and Cloud Logging for resource `cloud_run_job`.
